author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.30 shipped: Lighting menu label + colour-temperature slider
why: The operator found the new lighting menu row blank and the kelvin fields unusable: most people cannot map colour to a kelvin number. HA's colour-temperature selector shows the colour itself, so no custom swatch work is needed; guard tests stop both regressions recurring.
implications: Shipped ROOM-LIGHTING-SETUP-REDESIGN-1 at v5.103.30; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.30.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If any room menu row is blank or a typed kelvin field reappears, reopen.

refs.release_notes: The new Lighting step's menu item is now labelled 'Light Roles & Looks', and colour-temperature fields use HA's shaded colour-temperature slider instead of typed kelvin numbers.
